purpose: determine with one non-polling metadata request whether rank 47 has any distinct active BTC ETH or SOL option population after the consumed 2026-09-01 late-ticker delta before spending requests on prices or books

population_rule.new_symbol_definition: current eligible symbol absent from the hash-bound baseline eligible symbol set

decision_rules: If the current eligible set has no new symbols, terminalize only this exact observation and stop without ticker, futures book, depth, funding, fee, account, credential, order, or fund access.
If one or more new symbols exist, retain their complete metadata and freeze a separate two-request all-option-ticker plus all-futures-book prefilter before economic access.

The later price prefilter must use the displayed positive option ask and the correct side-specific perpetual entry, then require a positive terminal floor after the already frozen 33.5-bip fixed fee and expiry-basis stress.
Never infer executable quantity from exchangeInfo or ticker presence, and never request per-symbol depth unless a later fixed-stress row survives.
Never use credentials, access accounts, or place orders under this contract.
